posts.title: Morning Sunwatch
posts.text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — September 10, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.0 (Peaked September 10, 2026 at 07:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 448 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)

Pretty calm right now. 🌎

Several sunspot groups and broad coronal features are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward-moving structure.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center

posts.title: Midnight Sunwatch
posts.text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — September 10, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.5)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C3.2 (Peaked September 09, 2026 at 10:32 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 434 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)

Everything looks pretty calm. ☀💫

Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
